verdict.rationale: Elicit's Systematic Reviews workflow produces a research report summarizing papers with data extraction and screening tables, and Pro+ users can export these tables in CSV/Excel/RIS/BIB formats for sharing (elicit-docs-1, elicit-docs-19, elicit-docs-22, elicit-docs-25). However, there's no evidence of a single unified, formatted document combining narrative sections, tables, and an executive summary in one shareable artifact — reports and tables appear to be separate exports rather than an integrated stakeholder-ready report. Missing for 10: evidence of a single combined document/PDF export with sections+tables+summary, and independent corroboration of report quality/usability for stakeholder sharing.
